title: Image-only Inspector media pickers enforce the supported raster MIME family

defect.before: Image-only Inspector pickers did not request an image MIME filter, and the media listing endpoint did not support the image family. Audio and video files could appear in image/background/card/poster pickers and be stored in image-only fields.
defect.fix: Share the existing supported image MIME contract (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) between the Worker media route and Editor pickers. The listing endpoint applies a parameterized allowlist filter, and every image-only Inspector picker requests that family. Audio and video pickers retain their existing family filters.
defect.third_party_review: No external implementation was needed: this behavior is defined by the repository's upload validation and existing IMAGE_MIMES contract; reusing the project contract avoids a new dependency.
